# Jewelry GLB Models

Place production-ready `.glb` files in this folder.

The try-on code currently looks for:

- `chandbali-gold-earring.glb`
- `pearl-hoop-earring.glb`
- `temple-jhumka-earring.glb`

Recommended export settings from Blender:

- Format: glTF Binary (`.glb`)
- Apply transforms before export
- Origin near the earring stud or hook
- Model height roughly normalized; the app also normalizes height at runtime
- Use PBR materials with metallic, roughness, normal, and base color textures
- Keep each earring under 1-2 MB for smoother webcam try-on

Use only assets you created, commissioned, scanned, purchased, or downloaded with a license that allows use in your project.
